output_summary.description: A complex serializer for AdvancedProduct that demonstrates multiple relationship types and field transformations. This serializer handles product data including SKU, name, manufacturer, supplier details, location count, and locations. It uses a SerializerMethodField to dynamically calculate location counts and a CharField with source mapping to display supplier information.

sku.description: Unique stock keeping unit identifier for the product. Must be unique across all products in the system.

name.description: The full name or title of the product as displayed to customers.

manufacturer.description: Foreign key reference to the Manufacturer model that produces this product. Nullable if manufacturer information is unavailable.

supplier_details.description: Read-only field that displays the supplier's name by traversing the supplier relationship. Populated from the related Supplier model's name attribute.

location_count.description: Read-only computed field representing the total number of locations where this product is available. Calculated dynamically via the get_location_count method.

locations.description: Array of location IDs where this product is stocked. Each ID corresponds to a ProductLocation record in the database.
